title: SourceChainEntryView
description: Source of truth: Holochain agent source chain in imagodei DNA (Agent-Scoped, Category B). Entries are private to the authoring agent's source chain; they are never gossiped to the DHT. This view is read via the `query_my_source_chain` coordinator function and served by GET /api/v1/source-chain/{agentId}/entries.

actionHash.description: Hex-encoded ActionHash from the Holochain source chain record header.

entryHash.description: Hex-encoded EntryHash (hash of the serialized entry content).

authorAgent.description: Hex-encoded AgentPubKey that authored this entry.

entryType.description: Entry type discriminator as a string (e.g. 'Human', 'ContributorPresence', 'ContentMastery'). Derived from the record's action entry_type.

contentJson.description: JSON-serialized entry content. Null for App entries that cannot be decoded to a known type, or for system entries (Dna, AgentValidationPkg, InitZomesComplete).

prevActionHash.description: Hex-encoded ActionHash of the previous action in the chain. Null for the genesis record.

sequence.description: Zero-based sequence number of this record in the agent's source chain.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this entry was committed to the source chain.
